user.title: DB Storage Manager
user.description: Adds a DB Storage panel to the sidebar. Nothing is changed until you apply an action in the panel.

init.title: DB Storage Manager
init.description: How often to record the database size for the size-over-time chart (the size sensors update at the same time), and when the nightly retention job runs. The job only applies rules you created on the Entities tab; you can also turn it off and run it from your own automation with the db_storage_manager.run_retention action.

run_retention.name: Run retention rules
run_retention.description: Delete detailed states older than each entity's retention rule (set in the DB Storage panel). Long-term statistics are not touched.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: all (default) runs the whole job. count and record are the first and last steps of the maintained automation.
